decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 453.53 EUR for the extra posting. The disputed posting, TXN-008034 (453.53 EUR, posted 2026-08-24), was made 3 minutes after TXN-008033 (453.53 EUR, also posted 2026-08-24). Both are at LARKSPUR GETAWAYS (MER-000052) and carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008230. That authorisation was approved once for 453.53 EUR. So one authorisation was posted twice. The ledger shows no refund of either posting. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 67 days after posting, which is within the 120-day time limit. The later TXN-002867 (450.80 EUR, 2026-09-08) has a different amount and its own authorisation, so it is not part of this duplicate. Under the rule for one authorisation posted twice, provisional credit is approved for the extra posting. 453.53 EUR is below the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit.
